description: GAT topology validation sweep for TSMC Process dataset (11D node features: 7 base + 4 process params)

_comments.model_type: GAT (Graph Attention Network) with multi-head attention
_comments.heads_note: Number of attention heads. conv_hidden_dim should be divisible by heads for efficient computation
_comments.num_fc_layers_note: GAT supports only 2 or 3 FC layers
_comments.voltage_mode_options: all_nodes (voltage on all nodes), vdd_only (voltage only on VDD, 0 elsewhere)
_comments.normalization_options: zscore (z-score normalization, default), minmax (min-max to [epsilon, 1] range)
_comments.output_node_idx_note: output_node_idx is dynamically determined from topology cache
_comments.adaptation_method_options: selective_adam (grad/move + conditional Adam), adam (direct Adam, no grad/move)
_comments.inputport_note: Set 'inputport': true if using inputport topology. Adds _inputport suffix to paths.
_comments.related_pin_only_note: Set 'related_pin_only': true if using related_pin_only slew assignment. Adds _relpin suffix to paths.
